findings.highlight: I think that red knight sensed Saber’s presence beforehand.
findings.evidenceJa: あの赤い騎士は[ruby text=セイバー]敵を事前に感知していたように思える
findings.governingReading: Shirou thinks the red knight sensed an enemy beforehand; the ruby identifies that enemy as Saber.
findings.explanation: The English collapses the layered enemy/Saber wording into simple awareness of Saber, weakening the staged recognition clue.

findings.highlight: For him to take your first blow
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの一撃を受けるなんて
findings.governingReading: Shirou says it was abnormal for Archer to take one blow from Saber.
findings.explanation: “First” adds unsupported attack order to the evidence Shirou is reasoning from.

findings.highlight: it rather seems like you are protecting him
findings.evidenceJa: むしろ好意というか擁護しているように聞こえる
findings.governingReading: Saber says Shirou sounds fond of Archer, or at least as though he is defending him.
findings.explanation: The English omits the suggestion of affection that motivates Saber’s anxious question about which Servant Shirou would prefer.

findings.highlight: it is probably because of our compatibility
findings.evidenceJa: おそらく戦闘面での相性の問題でしょう
findings.governingReading: Saber tentatively explains her relief as a matter of combat compatibility.
findings.explanation: The English initially broadens the qualification to compatibility in general, blurring the rationalization Saber constructs around combat roles.
